user.title: Spanish Beach Flags (Cruz Roja)
user.description: Pick the autonomous community and enter one regular expression per line. They are matched case-insensitively against Cruz Roja's exact text "NAME - MUNICIPALITY (PROVINCE)", which does NOT include the word "Beach". For example, Malvarrosa beach in Valencia is listed as "MALVARROSA - VALENCIA (VALENCIA)": type "malvarrosa", not "Malvarrosa Beach".

data_description.patrones: Example: a line with "gandia" creates one sensor per beach in Gandia. Don't include the word "beach", it is not in the source data.
